item.title: TechGear — Production Responsive E-Commerce Web Application
item.dc:creator: Sunnatilla Sharipov
item.description: TechGear is a fully responsive digital tech store engineered by Sunnatilla Sharipov. Features dynamic REST API catalog integration, instant client-side search, multi-attribute filtering, shopping cart drawer state management, and dark/light mode toggle.

item.title: 3D Cyber City — WebGL Interactive Three.js Experience
item.dc:creator: Sunnatilla Sharipov
item.description: An interactive procedural 3D cyber city canvas showcase built with Three.js and custom GLSL shaders, featuring dynamic particle streams, smooth mouse parallax camera damping, and high 60fps performance across desktop and mobile browsers.
